en_US.title: Light-Delay Authority
en_US.scanner: No ansible lane exists here: every carrier reply is limited by light speed, relay queue, weather scatter and orbital geometry.
en_US.field_note: Physics is the first censor. Priority only decides which late answer leaves first.
en_US.terminal: COMM AUTHORITY: one-way delay valid. Relay queue loaded. Storm scatter high. Human override outside local survival window.
en_US.audio: Nobody ignored the call fast enough. Distance did it first.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Light-Delay Authority fixes HECTON-8 communication canon: no FTL, no ansible, no instant rescue. The player reads relay timing as route pressure.
en_US.external_site: Light-Delay Authority defines the 2190 no-ansible communication model: carrier signals obey light speed, queue priority, orbital windows and local weather.

en_US.title: Black Keel Tariff Table
en_US.scanner: The tariff plate prices distress, samples, custody seals and oxygen separately; survival is not the fastest billing class.
en_US.field_note: A rescue request and a sample manifest do not enter the same queue.
en_US.terminal: TARIFF CLASS: salvage emergency. Welfare addendum pending. Verified sample custody advances outbound priority by two billing tiers.
en_US.audio: The table has a price for rescue and a discount for evidence.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Black Keel Tariff Table turns corporate response into mechanics: distress, sample custody, oxygen debt and liability seals have different queue priority.
en_US.external_site: Black Keel Tariff Table defines the carrier economy around HECTON-8 rescue calls: billing class can outrank human urgency.

en_US.title: Marauder Graffiti Masks
en_US.scanner: The paint is a route mask: slash count marks noise discipline, black rings mark carrier-ping danger, and broken arrows mark pressure drift.
en_US.terminal: MASK LEGEND: three slashes mean silent route until pump wake. Black ring means do not answer carrier pings inside the canyon.
en_US.audio: They made a language that looks like vandalism to the company.
en_US.in_game_wiki: Marauder Graffiti Masks make scavenger markings usable evidence. The marks encode route safety, comms discipline, pressure drift and corporate signal traps.
en_US.external_site: Marauder Graffiti Masks define non-corporate wayfinding on HECTON-8: practical masks disguised as vandalism.
